index.sub: Real-time SOS, live GPS, voice activation and a direct line to police and hospitals — working even when you can't reach your phone.
index.featuresTitle: Built for emergencies that can't wait.
index.f1d: Hold once — your trusted circle, police and hospitals are alerted together.
index.f2d: Your moving location shared on a live link until you're safe.
index.f3d: Say "Help Me" or let crash/scream detection trigger it for you.
index.f4d: Location SMS to every contact, then a direct police call in 15s.
index.f5d: Trips, check-in timers and geofences watched by the people you trust.
index.f6d: Nearest verified police stations and hospitals, live distance and ETA.
index.ctaSub: Join thousands of women using Jeevan Raksha to stay protected, every day, everywhere.

settings.suggestBody: Would you like to use the app in {lang}?

voiceProtection.title: Voice Protection Mode
voiceProtection.activeSub: Emergency voice commands are being monitored. Status shows in the notification.
voiceProtection.inactiveSub: Turning this ON starts the native Android foreground service.
voiceProtection.commandsNote: When detected: GPS location → Google Maps link → alert SMS to emergency contacts → 112 call → emergency notification. The SOS button and Volume 3x use the same workflow.
voiceProtection.batteryWarn: Battery optimization can stop the service in the background. Allow "Unrestricted" battery usage.
voiceProtection.privacyBody: Audio is processed on-device only. Your voice is never recorded, stored or uploaded.
voiceProtection.limitsBody: Screen-off / background detection depends on your Android version and phone brand battery rules — continuous operation cannot be guaranteed on every phone.
voiceProtection.webNote: This native feature does not run in a browser. Install the Android app and toggle it here. Voice SOS (mic) on the website keeps working as usual.

fakeCall.title: Fake Call
fakeCall.sub: A realistic incoming call to help you leave an uncomfortable situation.
fakeCall.scheduled: Phone will ring in {time}. You can lock the screen or keep using the app.
fakeCall.tip: Keep the app open. The phone rings with sound and vibration like a real call.
